 Initial Big 12 Injury Report for Iowa State Released, Carson Kolb Out
 The Pokes will be without their starting tight end. 
 By Zachary Lancaster 
 October 29, 2026 
 1.3k Views 
 Discuss 
 Share Story 
 Share Story 
 Copy Link 
 Email 
 X 
 Facebook 
 Photo by John Diaz - Pokes Report 
 STILLWATER – Oklahoma State will be without its starting tight end on Saturday against Iowa State as Carson Kolb is listed as out on the Big 12 initial injury report on Wednesday night. 
 Also listed in the report for the Pokes is S Quinton Hammonds, WR Dayvon Standard and DT Landon Dean as all questionable and DE Malik Charles is listed as probable.
 The Cowboys are coming off a 57-24 win over Colorado this past weekend, while the Cyclones lost 39-3 to Arizona.
 Kickoff for the Pokes’ Halloween showdown up in Ames is scheduled for 6 p.m. CT and will be televised on FS1. The Cyclones announced earlier this week they’ll be wearing all black with white accent uniforms, so the Cowboys responded in kind as they’ll be wearing all orange.
